tools.name: Mute Video
tools.summary: Remove the audio track from a video.

tools.name: Replace Audio
tools.summary: Swap the audio track of a video with another file.

inputs.description: A video file followed by an audio file (exactly 2 files)

tools.name: Resize Video
tools.summary: Scale a video to a new resolution or preset size.

settings.name: preset
settings.description: One of: custom, 2160p, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p. When "custom", at least width or height is required

tools.name: Reverse Video
tools.summary: Play a video clip backwards. Limited to clips up to 5 minutes.

tools.name: Rotate Video
tools.summary: Rotate or flip a video.

settings.name: transform
settings.description: One of: cw90, ccw90, 180, hflip, vflip

tools.name: Stabilize Video
tools.summary: Reduce camera shake with two-pass stabilization.

tools.name: Trim Video
tools.summary: Cut a clip out of a video.

settings.name: endS
settings.description: End time in seconds (must be after startS)

settings.name: precise
settings.description: Re-encode for frame-accurate cuts instead of keyframe seek

tools.name: Video Color
tools.summary: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and gamma.

tools.name: Normalize Video Audio
tools.summary: Normalize video audio volume to broadcast standard (EBU R128).

tools.name: Clean Video Metadata
tools.summary: Strip metadata from a video and report what was found.

tools.name: Video Speed
tools.summary: Speed up or slow down a video.

settings.name: factor
settings.description: Speed multiplier (2 = double speed, 0.5 = half speed)

settings.name: keepPitch
settings.description: Preserve audio pitch when changing speed

tools.name: Video to Frames
tools.summary: Extract frames from a video as a ZIP of images.

settings.name: n
settings.description: Extract every Nth frame (used when mode is "nth")

settings.name: timestamps
settings.description: Comma-separated timestamps in seconds (required when mode is "timestamps")

tools.name: Video to GIF
tools.summary: Turn a video clip into an animated GIF.

tools.name: Video to WebP
tools.summary: Convert a video clip into an animated WebP image.

tools.name: Watermark Video
tools.summary: Burn a text watermark onto video frames.

settings.name: position
settings.description: One of: tl, tc, tr, l, c, r, bl, bc, br
